records.text: Concept catalog header: Mosaic Loadline — Concept. Definition: It is the planning principle that pairs every assumption with the observation that would invalidate it, so revisions can be limited to the affected steps.

Concept catalog header: Tideglass Margin — Concept. Interview record. Safiya Ren reported: "It is the sizing principle that sets a reserve from the widest gap among independent forecasts instead of from their average."
